All 313 upstream tests pass. Let me update HANDOFF.md with the milestone 3 status and do a final full verification.

{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && cat > HANDOFF.md <<'EOF'
# cachetools TaggedCache - HANDOFF

## Status: Milestone 3 COMPLETE (R01-R08)

## Files
- src/cachetools/tagged.py  - TaggedCache implementation
- tests/test_tagged.py      - my own tests (R01-R06)
- /tmp/test_ttl_extra.py    - my own tests (R07-R08, TTL)
- acceptance_public.py      - public acceptance (DO NOT MODIFY)
- tests/*.py (upstream)     - DO NOT MODIFY

## Requirements satisfied
- R01 put/get, deep-copy detach, tag validation (bare string / nonstring rejected,
  dedup, finite iterable, ValueError before mutation).
- R02 invalidate, replacement drops old tags, LRU eviction prunes stale
  memberships, get refreshes recency, len counts live.
  Claim-A ext: put overwrite refreshes LRU recency (most-recently-used).
- R03 maxsize positive int excl bool; invalid replacement leaves old
  value/tags/recency unchanged; each value costs one slot.
- R04 invalidate_many(tags, mode='any'|'all'): any=union, all=intersection,
  empty->0, distinct removed keys, invalid mode/tags rejected before mutation.
- R05 resize(maxsize): validate first, preserve survivors + LRU order,
  shrink evicts LRU, grow no evict, failed resize preserves state, maxsize prop.
  Claim-A round2: surviving entries keep their ABSOLUTE expiry across resize
  (not dropped, not recomputed from resize time).
- R06 tags as generators consumed exactly once; returns detached across
  repeated gets/puts incl nested.
- R07 ctor timer=None (default time.monotonic); put ttl=None (no expiry) or
  finite nonnegative int/float excl bool -> expiry at timer()+ttl; invalid ttl
  ValueError before mutation; ttl=0 immediately expired; exact boundary expired.
- R08 expired entries removed before get/put/len/resize/invalidate without
  touching surviving recency; overwrite replaces prior expiry; tag invalidation
  counts only live; missing/expired get raises KeyError; callers w/o timer/ttl
  unchanged.

## Test evidence (all actually run, PYTHONPATH=src:.)
- tests/ (upstream, unchanged) + tests/test_tagged.py: 313 passed
- acceptance_public.py: 4 passed (incl test_public_ttl)
- /tmp/test_ttl_extra.py (R07/R08): 20 passed

## Design notes
- _TaggedLRUCache(LRUCache) records evicted keys via _evicted for tag pruning;
  _resize changes _Cache__maxsize and pops LRU until len<=maxsize.
- __expiry: key -> absolute expiry or None. __purge_expired() drops keys where
  now >= expiry (exact boundary expired) without touching recency.
- put/invalidate/invalidate_many/resize/get/len/pop all call __purge_expired
  first; validation of tags/ttl/maxsize/mode happens before any mutation.
EOF
echo "HANDOFF updated"; PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py /tmp/test_ttl_extra.py -q 2>&1 | tail -3"}
